comments.text: Coober Pedy is pronounced wrongly. But it's understandable as it  is pronounced wrongly on Google, too. The 'e' sound in Pedy is the same as seed, not as in dead. Australians pronounce it with the ee sound

replies.author: @BecauseGeography
replies.text: Interesting thanks for pointing this out 👍

replies.text: Maybe a small 'Not generated by AI' text at the start would help. AI garbage is everywhere now. Viewers feel cheated when they suspect this

replies.text: Please enlighten me on what part of this is AI? I’ve had a few comments like this so far - everything about my videos is human-made by myself. I fear that it’s becoming too common that everyone’s default opinion of a video “must be AI” just because I don’t show my face.
